subject.title: [Feature]: Settings profile page — lifetime token stats, streaks, and activity heatmap

question: Should OpenClaw core accept a new Control UI settings profile page backed by additive `sessions.usage` aggregate fields via https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102842?
rationale: The request is a new core UI/product surface with Gateway RPC response additions, and the protected `maintainer` label means cleanup automation should not decide that direction.

options.title: Review the linked PR
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review the proposed core UI and gateway aggregate implementation in the linked PR.

options.title: Narrow the feature
options.body: Ask the PR author to reduce scope, split gateway aggregate changes from UI work, or defer nonessential profile widgets before acceptance.

options.title: Decline core surface
options.body: Close the PR and this issue only if maintainers decide a wrapped-style profile page does not belong in core Control UI.

recommendation.title: Review the linked PR
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review the proposed core UI and gateway aggregate implementation in the linked PR.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored this issue and the linked implementation and has recent current-main history on the Usage page surface.
